{{Short description|Czech physicist and author (born 1972)}}
{{BLP sources|date=June 2014}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=July 2022}}

'''Miroslav Žamboch''' (born 13 January 1972) is a Czech physicist and author known for writing novels and short stories in the [[science fiction]] and [[fantasy]] genres.<ref>Žamboch is discussed in each of the two genres in {{Cite book|author=Červenák, Ďuro|year=2004|title=Čas psanců: sborník fantasy a SF povídek (Time Outlaws: Anthology of Fantasy and SF Stories)|publisher=Triton|location=Prague|pages=63 and 217|isbn=80-7254-525-6}}</ref>

A native of the [[Moravia]]n town of [[Hranice (Přerov District)|Hranice]], Miroslav Žamboch graduated with a degree in [[physics]] from the Department of [[Nuclear engineering|Nuclear Sciences and Physical Engineering]] of the [[Czech Technical University in Prague]]. He works at the Institute for Nuclear Studies and, since the mid-1990s, has written over twenty novels and several collections of short stories.

In 2011, upon the occasion of his work translation to Korean, he has been described as a representative of the most recent generation of Czech science fiction and fantasy writers.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Anthology of modern Czech science fiction published in Korean|date=22 August 2011|publisher=Embassy of the Czech Republic in Seoul |url=http://www.mzv.cz/seoul/en/news_and_activities/seoul_anthology_of_modern_czech_science.html|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20140615011851/http://www.mzv.cz/seoul/en/news_and_activities/seoul_anthology_of_modern_czech_science.html|archivedate=15 June 2014|url-status=live}}</ref> As of 2013 at least seventeen of his books have been translated into [[Polish language|Polish]].<ref name=pyrkon>{{Cite web|title=Guests: Miroslav Žamboch|publisher=Pyrkon Convention|url=http://pyrkon.pl/2013en/index.php?go2=guests#zamboch|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20130609033712/http://pyrkon.pl/2013en/index.php?go2=guests#zamboch|archivedate=9 June 2013|url-status=dead|access-date=10 June 2014}}</ref>

Žamboch is also known as an outdoorsman and physical fitness enthusiast, having participated in [[judo]] exhibitions, [[amateur boxing]], [[mountain climbing]] and [[downhill cycling]].
